work-06.rationale: Indonesian presentasi and Malaysian pembentangan naturally denote a formal talk given to an audience. The forms are unrelated and create a useful national vocabulary contrast.

work-07.rationale: Indonesian wawancara kerja and Malaysian temu duga kerja naturally mean a job interview or employment-assessment meeting. They are unrelated forms and provide a useful contrast.

concerns: Indonesian lamaran can also refer to a marriage proposal, but kerja makes the employment sense clear.
work-08.rationale: Lamaran kerja and permohonan kerja naturally express a formal request or application for employment. The forms are unrelated and the pair teaches a useful contrast.

concerns: Perusahaan can sometimes emphasize an enterprise or business rather than the legal organization itself, but it commonly covers company in this context.
work-09.rationale: Indonesian perusahaan and Malaysian syarikat are ordinary terms for an organization conducting business. They are unrelated word forms and form a useful national contrast.

work-10.rationale: Indonesian lembur and Malaysian kerja lebih masa naturally mean work performed beyond normal working hours. The forms are unrelated and provide a useful everyday contrast.
